items.heading: Many Families Hear That Pcb
items.text: Many families hear that PCB leads to a doctor or to nothing. That is false, and the opposite habit is also costly: picking any BSc just because the stream says biology.

items.heading: Several Popular Courses Are Not
items.text: Several popular courses are not BSc degrees at all. They have their own regulator, entrance and length.

items.heading: The Order Is a Judgement,
items.text: The order is a judgement, not a rule. It places a course higher when income and reach can grow with skill, proof and a business layer, and lower when the only way up is a long ladder of exams.

items.heading: Choose Pcb Only If
items.text: Choose PCB only if you like biology and healthcare or life-science work and know how long the training paths run.

items.heading: If You Are Undecided
items.text: If you are undecided and can handle Maths, PCM keeps more doors open, although it closes medicine and some life-science routes.
